description: List variables/datasets, apply or create datasets, bind variables to objects, import/export variable XML, or generate artboards from CSV. import (XML) replaces ALL existing variables and datasets in the document. export refuses to replace an existing file unless overwrite is true. Note: import_csv and apply_dataset bring Illustrator to the foreground, because writing text contents while it is in the background blocks for minutes. import_csv does not create variables or datasets: it copies the objects on artboard 0 (left unchanged as the template) onto one new artboard per CSV row, placed to the right of existing artboards, and sets the text of copied text frames whose name matches a CSV header.

dataset_name_prefix.description: Prefix for auto-generated dataset names (for import_csv). If omitted, first column value is used.

file_path.description: File path (XML for import/export, CSV for import_csv)

object_name.description: Object name to bind variable to (for bind_variable)

overwrite.description: For export: replace the file if it already exists. Without this, an existing file is never overwritten.

name: manage_datasets
title: Manage Variables & Datasets
